attributes.name: overall page length
attributes.definition: How long or short the page is overall, in terms of amount of content and sections.

values.definition: Page is noticeably short, with few sections and little content.
Page has a typical amount of sections and content.
Page is long with many sections and repeated content.

attributes.name: hero height
attributes.definition: Vertical size of the hero/top banner section.

values.definition: Hero is compact and takes little vertical space.
Hero is very tall or full-viewport.

attributes.name: copy and link density
attributes.definition: Amount of text copy and links on the page.

values.definition: Minimal copy and few links or elements.
Typical amount of copy and links.

attributes.name: section background banding
attributes.definition: Whether page sections alternate background tones to separate them.

values.definition: Sections alternate between two background tones.
